description: Single source of truth for audit identity, file path and execution type. Loaded at runtime via scripts/registry_loader.py. execution_type: automated = executed by a validator script, manual = human checklist at delivery time, process = research-process node audit. validator_binding: canonical validator id that executes an automated audit (must be null for manual/process); issue #378. scope: checklist (default) = audit backed by a human checklist file, delivery = delivery-scope/virtual pipeline audit with checklist: null executed by a validator (issue #393).

audits.description: Academic route delivery audit: evidence hierarchy, venue labeling, publication-bias handling.
Last gate before delivery: question answered, key variables supported, bottom line actionable.
Forward-looking claims discipline gate: forecasts must carry source role, time basis and confidence signals.
Listed-company route delivery audit: research anchor, dated numbers, reported vs estimates separation.
Market-outlook route delivery audit: scenario structure, monitoring actionability, stakeholder implications.
Mid-research review node: visible current best answer, strongest evidence, missing evidence, cut branches.
Selection-memo final audit for option/choice routes: shortlist logic, comparison unit, ranking-reversal conditions.
Quantitative role labeling gate: numbers labeled as observed fact / proxy / assumption / model output; route-specific checks.
Regulatory route delivery audit: business impact, enforcement reality, graduated risk, jurisdiction handling.
Route activation node: primary route chosen before deep collection, boundary judgment documented, no escape-hatch misuse.
Inline citation and source-register gate: load-bearing claims traceable via [SN]/[IN]/[UN], register columns and mapping.
Startup-evaluation route delivery audit: PMF signals, funding overview, milestone framing, uncertainty bounds.
Technical-deep-dive route delivery audit: judgment presence, comparison dimensions, feasibility evidence, roadmap separation.
Shared-workflow audit: workflow spine evidence, no specialized-route escape hatch misuse.
Markdown-delivery pipeline gate: the report must satisfy structural delivery checks (headings, artifacts) so it can render to Markdown/PDF (issue #377). Delivery-scope audit — no human checklist.
Research Pack validation gate: pack headings, fields, statuses and cross-references must satisfy the pack contract. Delivery-scope audit — no human checklist.
